book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.ar: العملاق قعد عالأرض، ومد إيده، وبلش يلمسنا واحد واحد.
sentences.en: The giant sat on the ground, reached out its hand, and began feeling us one by one.

sentences.ar: كان يمسك الواحد، ويقلبه، ويعصر ذراعه، ويرميه.
sentences.en: It would pick one up, turn him over, squeeze his arm, and throw him down.
And I understood it was looking for the fattest.

sentences.ar: ولما وصل عليّ، عصرني، ولقاني نحيف من الجوع، ورماني.
sentences.en: And when it came to me, it squeezed me, found me thin from hunger, and threw me down.
And at last it seized the captain, and he was fat.

sentences.ar: ما بدي أحكي شو عمل فيه.
sentences.en: I do not want to say what it did to him.

sentences.ar: بس بعد ساعة، العملاق كان شبعان، ونام جنب النار.
sentences.en: But an hour later, the giant was full, and slept by the fire.
Its snoring like thunder.
Every day the same thing.
In the morning it goes out, and locks the door on us.
And in the evening it comes back, and takes one.

sentences.ar: وصرنا نقعد ونستنى الدور، زي الخراف.
sentences.en: And we sat waiting our turn, like sheep.

sentences.ar: وبليلة، قلت للباقي: بدنا نموت هون، واحد واحد؟
sentences.en: And one night, I said to the rest: are we going to die here, one by one?
One said: and what can we do?
It is stronger than all of us.
I said: stronger, but it sleeps.
And a sleeper has no strength.
We made a plan.

sentences.ar: بالنهار، لما طلع، جمعنا خشب من الساحة.
sentences.en: By day, when it went out, we gathered wood from the courtyard.
And we built a raft on the shore, and hid it.

sentences.ar: وبالليل، لما أكل ونام، أخدنا سيخين من الحديد.
sentences.en: And at night, when it had eaten and slept, we took two iron spits.
And we put them in the fire.
Until they were red.

sentences.ar: وحملناهم عشرة، ومشينا على مهل، لحد ما وقفنا فوق وجهه.
sentences.en: And ten of us carried them, and walked slowly, until we stood over its face.
And its one eye was closed.
I said: now.

sentences.ar: ودفشنا الحديد بعينه، بكل قوتنا، كلنا مع بعض.
sentences.en: And we drove the iron into its eye, with all our strength, all together.
And the giant gave a scream that shook the palace.

sentences.ar: وقام، وصار يدور بإيديه، ويكسر كل إشي.
sentences.en: And it got up, and began groping with its hands, breaking everything.

sentences.ar: وإحنا ركضنا بين إجريه، وطلعنا من الباب، وركضنا عالشط.
sentences.en: And we ran between its legs, out the door, and ran for the shore.
And the giant behind us, blind, screaming, stumbling.
And we threw the raft into the water, and jumped on it.
